name: screen-vocab
description: 屏词 — 从屏幕/字幕轨/粘贴取词，英→中释义；iPhone/iPad/iPod/Mac/Watch；耳机 TTS、眼镜语音、头带回读

scripts.start: npm run build && npx --yes serve www -p 5191
scripts.sync:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync:android && cd android && JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/Cellar/openjdk@17/17.0.19/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home}" ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.mobile:android: npm run sync:android && npm run open:android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run sync:ios && npm run open:ios
